name: Graveyard counts and conditions lock as a spell or ability resolves
notes: Conor, 2026-11-22: a spell's or fired ability's graveyard count and condition are read as it resolves (cast or fired), not as the graveyard changes afterwards; a trigger's "if" is checked as it is fired. Your graveyard at first: Craw Wurm, Grizzly Bears, Shock (two card types, two creature cards, two permanent cards). Graverobber Spider fired then: +2/+2. Violent Urge on Goblin Guide and Join the Dead on Hill Giant cast then: no double strike, -5/-5. Five more cards go in (five card types, five permanent cards, three creature cards, eight cards): Violent Urge on Raging Goblin now gives double strike, Crypt Feaster's threshold trigger fires (+2/+0), and the earlier ones stay as they were.
